license_note: The official model card and Google's Gemma 4 license page apply Apache-2.0 to the published weights, tokenizer, and chat template. The Gemma Terms of Use that govern earlier Gemma generations explicitly refer Gemma 4 to the separate Apache-2.0 license, so no use-restriction addendum applies to this release.
